detail: Unconditional sqlite stamping on an old-Node creator's machine produces a config claiming sqlite while the server runs the files fallback and accumulates legacy state — a new-Node teammate would then boot an empty database next to real legacy files, exactly the silent-amnesia scenario the resolution rule exists to prevent, but inside a team. Stamping what will actually run keeps config.yml honest; files-stamped projects keep version 1 so 1.x teammates still work.
summary: DEVIATION from proposal: fresh init stamps backend by sqliteAvailable() (sqlite/version-2 when available, files/version-1 otherwise) instead of stamping sqlite unconditionally
